Maddy: Quick escalation  OrionLedger POC demo at 30m. Customers reporting burst 401s + 429s during load tests. Need hot-swarm. @Ravi @Elena can you join?

Ravi: Looking. 401 + 429 combo usually means token issues plus limiter. Share sample SDK logs and rate headers pls.

Maddy: Sent DM with logs. Example: HTTP/1.1 401 {"error":"invalid_api_key"} then later X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0 and 429. They upgraded auth-proxy yesterday.

Elena: Infra shows failed introspect calls to our endpoint at 2027-01-05T16:04:12Z followed by limiter tripping. Logs (sanitized):
"2027-01-05T16:04:12Z req=ol-21 ip=18.205.33.11 path=/v1/generate status=401 err="invalid_api_key" token=tmp-45
2027-01-05T16:04:13Z req=ol-22 ip=18.205.33.11 path=/v1/generate status=429 err="rate_limit_exceeded" X-RateLimit-Remaining=0"

Diego: Their proxy mints 10s tokens. If introspect occasionally times out, clients will retry and create bursts.

Priya: Security suspicion: JWKS fetch failing or proxy clock skew. Any JWKS errors in our logs?

Elena: Yes, intermittent JWKS fetch 504s from their proxy. Filed INF-2201 to track.

Ravi: Quick mitigations: A) provide server demo key for the immediate run, B) temporarily raise their TPS on the Dedicated pool, C) add a token validation grace window. Recommend A+B for safety.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: applied rate_limit=280 for customer=orionledger by infra at 2027-01-05T16:07:02Z

Maddy: They switched to server key mid-demo and traffic smoothed. 401s dropped ~95%. 429s are minimal after bump.

Anya: I'll update the POC checklist: require token refresh test after proxy deploys and capture proxy version on onboarding.

Sara: (cc) I27ll waive demo burst fees and prepare a brief amendment for the POC.

Priya: Security OK for server key for demo only. Condition: rotate key within 8 hours and log in SEC-883.

Ravi: I'll write the incident timeline and link INF-2201. Follow-ups: add JWKS failure alerts, automate pre-warm cache for demos, and update runbook.

Maddy: Demo completed successfully. Thanks everyone. Closing unless objections. :thumbsup:
